visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a three-way split screen showing the same woman in different costumes: a pink nurse uniform, a blue denim shirt with a black wig, and a light blue reporter's shirt. Large white text overlays the center. (2) The scene shifts to the woman dressed as a nurse in a dimly lit hospital room; she cradles a doll wrapped in a blanket like a baby, her facial expression appearing frantic and stressed as she gestures with her hands. (3) Transition to an outdoor street scene where the woman, now a reporter with a microphone and shoulder bag, staggers as the camera shakes violently to simulate an earthquake; she holds her smartphone up to record. (4) The woman appears as a male tutor with short black hair in an office setting, holding a clipboard and talking to a person whose back is to the camera. (5) A montage follows showing the nurse bandaging a patient's arm, the reporter standing in a crowded metro car holding a handrail, and the tutor being swamped by hands holding papers in a classroom with a whiteboard. (6) All three versions of the woman look tired and sigh toward the camera before a blue and white box of pastries is presented to them. (7) Close-up shots showcase the '不二糕餅' egg yolk pastries, which are round and golden-brown with black sesame seeds on top; the woman is shown biting into one with a joyful and satisfied expression. (8) The final scene shows the reporter eating the pastry on a train, looking startled as a text overlay suggests she is being caught eating in a restricted area.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main creator playing 3 roles, 1 female parent extra, 2 female student extras in background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long dark hair, appearing in three distinct costumes: a pink nurse outfit with a cap, a blue reporter shirt with a lanyard, and a short black wig with a blue denim shirt acting as a male tutor.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between a grey-walled hospital room, a busy city street corner, an office with shelves full of folders, a classroom with a whiteboard covered in mathematical formulas, and the interior of a modern metro train with stainless steel poles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched SFX of a baby crying triggers the opening; a fast-tempo, upbeat synth-pop BGM with a strong percussive beat begins. The female speaker uses a high-pitched, hurried, and breathy tone. (2) SFX of a low-frequency rumbling sound and wind whooshing accompanies the transition to the reporter scene; the vocal intensity increases to a shouting, high-arousal reporting style. (3) SFX of sharp paper rustling and a mechanical click occurs; the voice shifts to a lower, more authoritative tone as the tutor, while a secondary female voice speaks with a sharp, complaining pitch contour. (4) SFX of a digital chime/ding marks a scene shift; the BGM maintains its energetic tempo as the woman's voice reflects fatigue and sighing. (5) SFX of a 'pop' and 'magic sparkle' sound occurs as a warm, professional male voiceover enters with a calm and welcoming tone. (6) SFX of a loud, crisp crunching sound is prominent as the woman bites into a pastry; the BGM swells into a festive, melodic major-key theme with bright strings. (7) SFX of a train's arrival bell and a record scratch occurs at the end; a final male voice speaks with a sharp, stern tone, cutting against the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Problem -> Solution -> CTA. The video first presents a series of comical, high-stress occupational challenges preventing holiday reunions, then shifts to the emotional comfort provided by the product, ending with a call to purchase.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for '不二糕餅' egg yolk pastries. It uses comedic skits featuring common occupations that work through the Mid-Autumn Festival to build emotional rapport with the audience, framing the pastries as a symbol of 'reunion' and comfort for those who cannot go home.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The second half of the video is entirely dedicated to showcasing the brand '不二糕餅', its packaging, and the product features with a professional voiceover and clear call to action.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a popular 'role-playing' skit format common on social media to maintain high engagement before transitioning into a direct commercial endorsement. The high-density visual and audio editing is characteristic of viral short-form content.
